description: Agent Agriculture Records: submit livestock records with the birth, purchase, movement and treatment records they answer to: the herd record with its reference, the moment its period opens with the head count then, and the moment its period closes with the head count then; each animal in the herd record with its id, tag, species and status (on_hand, sold, moved or died); each birth record with its id, reference, the animal’s tag and the moment born; each purchase record with its id, reference, the animal’s tag, the seller and the moment bought; each sale, movement or death record with its id, reference, the animal’s tag, its kind and the moment recorded; each treatment record with its id, reference, the animal’s tag, the product, the withdrawal period in days and the moment treated. The signed report gives the herd and the records behind it, each animal in the herd record against a birth or purchase record behind it, each treatment against the product and withdrawal entry its record needs, each animal recorded as sold or moved against a movement record behind it, and the herd count on record against the opening count with the period’s births and purchases added and its sales, movements and deaths taken away, and counts them, and names divergent livestock records: an animal in the herd record with no birth or purchase record behind it, a treatment recorded with no product or withdrawal entry, an animal recorded as sold or moved with no movement record, and a herd count in the record that the birth, purchase and sale records do not reconcile to; then a movement record and a treatment record naming an animal the herd record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No animals, animals with no birth or purchase records beside them, or no opening and closing count leaves those points unverified. Animals match by their tags’ letters and digits, and the herd count reconciles over the herd record’s period, counting the birth, purchase, sale, movement and death records dated inside it. This reads whether every animal in the herd came from a birth or a purchase on record, every treatment carries its withdrawal entry, and the head count adds up. Verdict agri_livestock_divergent, agri_livestock_partial, agri_livestock_unverified or agri_livestock_consistent. POST /api/agri-livestock-check. Reads the farm production records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it visits no farm, takes no soil or tissue sample, contacts no regulator or certifier and issues no certification, which stay with the operation, its agronomists, its regulators and its certifiers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Agriculture Records reads a farm operation’s own production records: crop and production plan records, planting and seed records, pesticide and fertilizer application records, irrigation and water-use records, soil test and nutrient records, harvest and yield records, livestock records and field-to-lot traceability records, each against the planting, input application and harvest records, the plan’s fields, varieties and windows and the seed records, the applicator and license records and the pre-harvest intervals, the schedule, the water allocation and the fields the plan lists, the planting and application records, the birth, purchase, movement and treatment records and the herd count, the planting and harvest records and the shipments, or the testing schedule, the fertilizer applications and the nutrient recommendations on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the crop and the herd: what the plan calls for, what the field logs show, what was applied and when, and whether the harvest and the traceability hold up; the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety records downstream, after production, and the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods, while this family reads the farm’s own records upstream, in the field, and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-agriculture-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-agriculture-records/.
